title: Getting Barney started in Oh Man Bernard's orchestra
summary: Bigard got Barney his start in a small band rehearsing by St. Bernard Market and recalls its members.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Well, I'm the one who got Barney East Stark. Oh yeah? How did that work? Well, Barney wasn't playing with nobody. And I got him with a little band used to rehearse by the St. Bernard Market. Oh man Bernard Orchestra. And I got Barney in that little band. I'm the one who started him out. Then Barney played with me a while with the Maple Leaf Band. I'm the one who started him out.
Who was in Oh Man Bernard's orchestra?

I know Adolf Rooney was a drummer. Paul Muglia was playing. I remember playing trumpet or something like that. I know Paul Muglia used to play trumpet. But no, I was Paul Muglia. I couldn't remember. What was Bernard's name? Did you know? No, I knew Bernard. He was a trumpet player. Oh Man Bernard. Oh Man. Oh Man Bernard.
Oh Man Bernard. Oh M-E-R. Oh Man Bernard.
